text:
ana: kicking off narrow-weight swap to router v4.1 at 2025-10-02T03:00Z. plan: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 25m. change window reserved. release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/v4.1

deploy-bot: rollout created r-20251002-0300. auto-advance enabled. thresholds default.

devops: FYI perf lab saw a small p95 rise at 30% under heavy embeddings workload.

ravi: set rollback thresholds: p95 >1.7x OR 5xx >0.6% for 4m. keep auto-advance but notify @devops on each step.

ana: agreed. ops prepare quick revert commands.

devops: revert ready:
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v4.0 --weight 100
routerctl set-weight --service frontend --version v4.1 --weight 0
routerctl drain-connections --service frontend --version v4.1 --timeout 180

deploy-bot: step1 (2%) applied at 1741001242.

ravi: monitoring metrics. step1 looks good.

ravi: at T+12m p95 trend slight upward but within bounds. proceed to 10%.

deploy-bot: step2 (10%) applied at 1741001270.

devops: seeing a 5xx spike to 0.3% for 30s then back. not sustained. no abort.

ana: proceed to 30%.

deploy-bot: step3 (30%) applied at 1741001288.

ravi: metrics stable, no rollback. marking rollout COMPLETE at 1741001290.

ana: adding post-rollout note: monitor long-tail latency for 48h. will run extended perf job tomorrow.
